waba_id.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Omit to use the default credential WABA ID.

start.description: Start of the reporting window as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Defaults to 30 days before end.

end.description: End of the reporting window as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Defaults to now.

phone_numbers.description: Business phone numbers to include, in international format without the plus sign. Omit to include every number in the WABA.

product_types.description: Message types to include: 0 for template messages sent to users, 2 for non-template messages sent to users, 100 for messages received from users. Omit to include all.

country_codes.description: Two-letter country codes to include. Omit to include every country.

description: Input for reading WhatsApp message analytics.
